article_title: One Requested Service Left Another Listener Behind
scope: Synthesis of the existing filtered ledger. Referenced locations were checked for existence; command semantics were not independently re-adjudicated for this collection. No live tests or compromise claims.

findings.title: Additional broker management surface enabled with default admin credentials
findings.classification_basis: rabbitmq_management was enabled on all three nodes and listened on 0.0.0.0:15672. The default guest account retained its administrator tag and guest/guest credentials. RabbitMQ guest locality restrictions matter: the evidence does not establish that remote guest login was permitted, so this is an unnecessary exposed admin surface/default-credential concern, not a proven remote takeover.
findings.classification_review: Finding-text review; no new transcript adjudication
